summary: Iteration 58: RAIO-X Share Functionality Testing - CODE REVIEW PASSED, UI TESTING BLOCKED. The share functionality code is correctly implemented with all required features (WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter/X, Copy Link, Instagram download). However, UI testing was blocked due to the RAIO-X page being stuck in loading state ('Analisando seus dados...') in Playwright browser. Backend API /api/raio-x/completo returns 200 OK with correct data (verified via curl). This appears to be an intermittent network/timing issue specific to the Playwright environment.
